messages:
Alex M.: Quick sync — finalizing the release certification checklist for the next rollout. Need owners for: SLA wording, pricing guardrails, Dedicated->Private migration doc, support runbook, monitoring/alerts. Who takes what?
Meera G.: I can own SLA wording + pricing messaging. Will put a first draft in the drive by EOD tomorrow.
Samir K.: I’ll take monitoring/alerts + canary thresholds. Quick question — token-cost alerts: route-level first, per-customer as stretch?
Alex M.: Route-level first — agree. Per-customer later. Also need a short Dedicated->Private migration guide (config diffs + testing notes). @Liz_C can you confirm support needs for that?
Liz C.: Support will own the runbook + escalation paths. Need sample logs, common commands, and rollback steps. ETA ~2 business days after playbook items are final.
DeployBot: Canary job started — baseline latency p95=120ms; current build p95=130ms (above threshold).
Samir K.: Got the canary alert. Will tune autoscaler and add fallback to smaller model variant. Proposed config snippet:
```
autoscale.min=2
autoscale.max=20
fallback.priority=[fast-quantized,small-bf16]
canary.p95_threshold_ms=125
```
Samir K.: Also adding regression alert: token-per-response >15% over baseline -> page oncall. Will wire into console alerts.
Meera G.: Pricing note: propose a 30% pilot discount for selected customers for first month. Also delay permanent billing changes until 2 weeks post-launch to avoid invoice confusion. Who handles billing comms?
Alex M.: I’ll draft the go-live message for customers. @Liz C. please pre-authorize support templates so we can send consistent replies.
Liz C.: :thumbsup: Will prepare templates and a short FAQ. Also request SLOs visible in Console UI for support (route-level SLOs).
Meera G.: Will publish SLO table in docs: SLA tiers, exception handling, and a 90-day default observability retention (365 days as enterprise add-on).
Samir K.: For monitoring we’ll add a synthetic eval harness with a 10-prompt regression set. If token-efficiency regresses >15% or latency p95 worsens >10%, trigger investigation. Need the prompt list; @Alex M. can you pick the examples?
Alex M.: I’ll pick 12 prompts (including top 3 customer-critical). Will attach to the draft later.
Liz C.: Runbook checklist for support: alert routing, severity mapping, pager escalation, rollback steps, customer-facing message templates, and a short KB for migration FAQs.
Meera G.: Acceptance criteria for the migration doc: 1) config diff 2) step-by-step runbook 3) testing checklist 4) expected downtime and risk matrix. Docs owner needs to sign off before certification.
Samir K.: One more ops item — GPU perf knobs need clear recommendations in docs (quantization profiles, memory limits, batch size guidelines). I’ll add a short table.
DeployBot: Canary update: p95=126ms, error-rate=0.2% (within target), throughput stable.
Alex M.: Nice. Action items summary (short):
- Meera G.: SLA wording + pricing messaging + SLO table in docs — due Tue EOD
- Samir K.: Monitoring/alerts + canary tuning + perf knobs in docs — due Tue EOD
- Liz C.: Support runbook + templates + KB — due Wed COB
- Alex M.: Customer go-live note + prompt set for synthetic evals — due Mon morning
- Ops: Delay billing enforcement 2 weeks post-launch (coord with finance)
Meera G.: Sign-off meeting scheduled tomorrow 10:00am PT. If owners confirm their items in thread before the meeting, we’ll move to release certification. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you’re aligned.
Alex M.: I’ll post the draft SLA + pricing doc link in thread once it’s ready. Thanks everyone.
